design_philosophy.core_motto: From Culture to Commerce - Warmth, Honor, Craft & Tactile Digital Runway
fusion_disciplines: Editorial Swiss typography with rich contrast
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix craft heritage with high-end digital flagship polish.
Emotion First: Evoke pride, authenticity, warmth, trust, and global connection.
Content is King: Celebrate the vendor stories and artisan roots in every layout.
Tactile Framing: Deep rich neutral bases (#0E0C0A charcoal, #FAF7F2 warm warm linen) paired with Terracotta (#C85A32), Royal Gold (#D9822B), and Deep Indigo (#1E2338) accents.

testing_and_accessibility.mandatory_data_testid_rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST have kebab-case data-testid attributes.
testing_and_accessibility.accessibility_rules: Ensure all buttons have focus-visible outline rings, clear 4.5:1 text contrast over terracottas and indigos, and aria labels for icon-only buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read and adhere strictly to this design_guidelines.json file.
2. Maintain permanent AfroVending design system consistency across all routes and future phase builds.
3. Implement the shared Header, Footer, Home Page, Design System Showcase (/design-system), 404 Page, and Coming Soon routes.
4. Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, links, and cards include explicit data-testid attributes.
5. Use Lucide icons (Search, User, ShoppingBag, ArrowRight, ShieldCheck, Sparkles, Check, ChevronRight, Menu, X, ExternalLink).
6. Do not use plain white or default generic Tailwind styles. Use AfroVending warm neutral backgrounds (#FAF7F2), Terracotta (#C85A32), Warm Gold (#D9822B), and Deep Indigo (#1E2A38).
7. Clean up any emergent stock splash components from App.js.
